<function=python>
<parameter=code>
res = action(['SPACE'])
print({k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','done','level_completed','game_over','run_complete','reward','score')})
a = current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
for n in a:
    if n['color'] in ('W','N') or n['pixels']<=24:
        b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
        print(n['id'], n['color'], n['pixels'], "r",min(rows),"-",max(rows),"c",min(cols),"-",max(cols))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
